country.headline: Suarez handballed on the line to deny Ghana a World Cup semi-final, and Gyan missed the penalty
country.backstory: In the 2010 World Cup quarter-final, Ghana were on the verge of becoming the first African team to reach a semi-final. In the final minute of extra time, Dominic Adiyiah's header was cleared off the line by Luis Suarez's deliberate handball. Suarez was sent off but celebrated on the sideline when Asamoah Gyan hit the crossbar with the resulting penalty. Uruguay won the shootout.
country.trigger: Ghana plays Uruguay in World Cup 2026; any handball controversy; Africa's quest for a semi-final

country.headline: Eusebio scored four as Portugal came back from 3-0 down against North Korea
country.backstory: North Korea raced to a 3-0 lead against Portugal in the 1966 World Cup quarter-final at Goodison Park. Eusebio, in tears during the onslaught, took over the match single-handedly, scoring four goals as Portugal completed one of the greatest comebacks in World Cup history, winning 5-3. Eusebio wept again at full time, this time in relief.
country.trigger: Any team comes back from 3-0 down at World Cup 2026; any great individual performance

country.headline: Japan beat Spain with a goal that was millimeters from being out, topping a group of death
country.backstory: Japan beat both Germany and Spain to top their 2022 World Cup group. The winning goal against Spain by Ao Tanaka was initially ruled out because the ball appeared to have crossed the line. VAR review showed millimeters of the ball were still on the line, and the goal stood. Japan eliminated Germany in the process, as results elsewhere went against them.
country.trigger: Japan plays Spain or Germany in World Cup 2026; any tight VAR call

country.headline: Zambia's entire national team was killed in a plane crash, and the country rebuilt from nothing
country.backstory: On April 27, 1993, a plane carrying the Zambian national team crashed into the Atlantic Ocean off Gabon, killing all 30 people on board. Zambia rebuilt their team from scratch with young players and domestic league players. In 2012, Zambia won the Africa Cup of Nations in Gabon, near the site of the crash, completing one of football's most emotional stories.
country.trigger: Zambia plays in any tournament; any plane crash or disaster reference; any African football story

country.headline: Wales beat the world's number-two ranked team to reach their first ever semi-final
country.backstory: Wales, ranked 117th just five years earlier, beat second-ranked Belgium 3-1 in the Euro 2016 quarter-final in Lille. Ashley Williams equalized with a powerful header, Hal Robson-Kanu scored a Cruyff-turn goal, and Sam Vokes sealed it late. It was Wales' first major tournament semi-final since 1958, and the entire nation of three million celebrated.
country.trigger: Any small nation beats a top-ranked team in World Cup 2026

country.headline: James Rodriguez scored one of the greatest World Cup goals ever to knock Uruguay out
country.backstory: In the 2014 World Cup round of 16, James Rodriguez received a long ball with his back to goal, controlled it on his chest, turned, and volleyed an unstoppable shot into the top corner from 25 yards. Colombia won 2-0, with James scoring both. The goal is widely considered one of the five greatest in World Cup history.
country.trigger: Colombia plays Uruguay in World Cup 2026; any World Cup wonder goal; James at World Cup

country.headline: The Netherlands came back from 1-0 down to beat Brazil 2-1 in the quarter-final
country.backstory: Brazil took the lead through Robinho and seemed to be cruising against the Netherlands. Wesley Sneijder equalized with a deflected shot, then headed in the winner from a corner. The Dutch went on to reach the final, while Brazil's elimination continued their post-2002 World Cup curse under heavy favorite expectations.
country.trigger: Netherlands plays Brazil in World Cup 2026; any quarter-final comeback

country.headline: German goalkeeper Schumacher nearly killed Battiston with a brutal foul and was not even booked
country.backstory: In the 1982 World Cup semi-final, German goalkeeper Harald Schumacher charged into French defender Patrick Battiston, knocking him unconscious and breaking his jaw, displacing vertebrae, and knocking out two teeth. Schumacher was not even given a foul. France still took the match to penalties but lost, and the incident remains one of the most brutal unpunished fouls in football history.
country.trigger: Germany plays France in World Cup 2026; any brutal foul or goalkeeper collision

country.headline: Australia qualified for their first World Cup in 32 years through a dramatic playoff
country.backstory: Australia had not qualified for a World Cup since 1974, suffering heartbreaking near-misses including a controversial loss to Argentina in 1993. In 2005, they beat Uruguay in a penalty shootout after a 1-1 aggregate draw, with goalkeeper Mark Schwarzer saving the decisive kick. The entire country erupted, and they went on to beat Japan at the 2006 World Cup with three goals in the final eight minutes.
country.trigger: Australia plays in World Cup 2026; any team qualifies after a long drought

country.headline: 5000-to-1 outsiders Leicester City won the Premier League
country.backstory: Leicester City, who had nearly been relegated the previous season, won the 2015-16 Premier League title at odds of 5000-to-1, the greatest underdog story in the history of team sport. Led by Claudio Ranieri, Jamie Vardy, Riyad Mahrez, and N'Golo Kante, they beat billion-dollar squads from Manchester, London, and Liverpool.
country.trigger: Any massive underdog story at World Cup 2026; Vardy, Mahrez, or Kante in discussion

country.headline: Italy ended Spain's challenge with a penalty shootout victory in the Euro semi-final
country.backstory: Italy and Spain played one of the best matches of Euro 2020 in the semi-final at Wembley. After a 1-1 draw, the match went to penalties. Gianluigi Donnarumma saved Alvaro Morata's penalty, and Jorginho scored the winner to send Italy to the final. Morata was devastated, adding to his long history of being scapegoated by Spanish fans despite his consistent goal record.
country.trigger: Italy plays Spain in World Cup 2026; any penalty shootout
